'''The Great Conch''' is a large island located in the [[Unquiet Ocean]] south of [[Menaphos]]. It is the home of the [[Tortugan]] species. A settlement named [[The Summer Shore]] is located on the southern shore and has a [[docking point]] requiring 45 [[Sailing]] and partial completion of [[Troubled Tortugans]] to use.

Among the island's features are a [[calquat patch]] to the west of the Summer Shore, a [[coral patch]] off the eastern dock, [[Woodcutting]] trees including [[Jatoba tree|jatoba]] and [[camphor tree]]s, [[Mining]] spots, an area for [[crab trapping]], [[hermit crab]]s for combat training as well as the [[Gryphon]] slayer monsters and their boss variant, the [[Shellbane Gryphon]].

The [[Quests/Series#Tortugan|Tortugan quest series]] is a [[Quests/Series|series of quests]] taking place on and around the Great Conch. Starting [[Troubled Tortugans]], the first quest in the series, is required to access the Great Conch.

==Transportation==
After starting the quest [[Troubled Tortugans]] and giving the bandage to [[Floopa]], the Great Conch can be visited by:
* Using the [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|cjq}}
* Taking a [[charter ship]]
* Sailing to the docking point on the south side of the island

==Features==
* [[The Great Conch bank]]
*[[Elder Strom's Hunting Stall]]
*[[Elder Raley's Herblore Stall]]
*[[Elder Blunn's Spear and Shield Stall]]
*[[Elder Krill's Fishing Stall]]
*[[Elder Coco's Crafting Stall]]
*[[Elder Reggle's Farming Shop]]

===Skill training spots===
The island contains the following skilling spots:
* [[Jatoba tree|Jatoba]] and [[camphor tree]]s.
* [[Hermit crab]]s on [[Cape Conch]] to the south-east.
* [[Gryphon]]s and the [[Shellbane Gryphon]].
* The following are available for [[Hunter|hunting]]:
** [[Tropical wagtail]]
** [[Blue crab]] - on the north & east beaches
** [[Black warlock]] - many spawns in the hunting area east of [[The Sacred Grove]]
** [[Carnivorous chinchompa]] - hunting area east of the town on top of the hill.
** [[Orange salamander (Hunter)|Orange salamander]] - on the north-western [[Abalone Cliffs]]
* A [[Sand pit]] is available south-east of the bank.
* [[Farming]] patches:
** [[Coral nursery (patch)|Coral nurseries]] off the eastern dock
** A [[calquat patch]] west of the Summer Shore
* [[Fishing]] spots:
** Several [[Fishing spot (big net, harpoon)]] on the south beach near the dock
** Several [[Rod Fishing spot (lure, bait)]] on the pond near the [[The Summer Shore]]
** Several [[Fishing spot (cage, harpoon)]] on the north beach
